purpose: Fix the dimensionless coordinates used to describe the pressure-regeneration phase map before outcomes are inspected.

replacement_compensation_ratio.definition: (treatment cumulative recruited represented population since anchor - paired no-disruption cumulative recruited represented population since anchor) / treatment cumulative underground disruption since anchor
replacement_compensation_ratio.undefined_rule: If direct disruption mass is zero, report null rather than dividing by zero.
replacement_compensation_ratio.interpretation: Positive rho means pressure induced extra recruitment; negative rho means the disrupted branch recruited less than its paired no-disruption branch.

pressure_induced_metabolic_load.definition: 1.92 * (treatment cumulative recruited represented population - paired no-disruption cumulative recruited represented population) / anchor canonical insurgent capital
pressure_induced_metabolic_load.interpretation: First-order fraction of anchor liquid-capital runway consumed or saved by pressure-induced replacement flow under the source-derived equipment-cost coefficient.

total_recruitment_metabolic_load.definition: 1.92 * cumulative recruited represented population since anchor / anchor canonical insurgent capital
total_recruitment_metabolic_load.interpretation: First-order recruitment-linked load on anchor capital runway; it is an accounting coordinate, not a claim that all capital movement is caused by recruitment.

predeclared_descriptives: Report mean, median, range, and normal 95% interval for rho and Delta_Lambda_K at each recruitment multiplier.
Report total Lambda_K by rate and disruption condition.
Report phase coordinates separately for active and collapsed final organizations if any collapses occur.
Do not select a universal rho or Lambda_K threshold from this 12-seed grid.
